msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia perfumes-casa-grande-20.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury beauty campaign still life of a tall ornate gold perfume bottle with a gold cap standing on its open black presentation box from the reference. The product stands in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm cinematic light, rich textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia perfumes-casa-grande-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a black perfume bottle with a silver chain and medallion, in its open black box from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia perfumes-casa-grande-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a dark grey perfume bottle with a black textured cap and a silver band from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia perfumes-casa-grande-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a dark amber glass perfume bottle with a gold and black emblem from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia perfumes-casa-grande-14.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a round red perfume bottle with a red cap, next to its red box from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail.
